correctness.rationale: For invertible structure matrices, the ideal argument gives absolute simplicity exactly for strongly connected supports. Uniform nonzero rows give each singleton cut exact conditional probability (q-1)/(q^n-1); all overlaps and cuts of sizes 2 through n-2 are O_q(n^2 q^-2n). Elduque--Labra group scheme exact sequence and one loop show a strongly connected asymmetric support has trivial automorphism functor on every commutative coefficient ring. A union bound over independent support-edge permutations yields the explicit exponential estimate. Finite checker independently enumerates 31,617 perfect algebras over prime fields and has no certificate false positive. General proof does not depend on these tests.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A theorem for generic unconditioned dense random directed graphs cannot directly imply the sharp 2n(q-1)/(q^n-1) conditional law because the edges cease to be independent after conditioning on invertibility. Residual equivalence risk remains for papers on conditional random digraphs.

value.rationale: The 2026 evolution-algebra survey explicitly asks for random simplicity and automorphism probability laws (Question 22). Sharp conditional simplicity failure with constant 2n(q-1)/(q^n-1), unconditional simplicity asymptotic, and explicit high-probability triviality of the entire automorphism group scheme jointly resolve a natural perfect-algebra slice, not an arbitrary parameter substitution. Distinguishes non-simplicity from singularity and rational automorphism points from infinitesimal group-scheme symmetries.
